note: GDP and remittances are World Bank figures, shown for economic scale only. No aggregate, country-of-origin football transfer income series exists in any source found for these three countries (or, for that matter, for most African exporting nations) - so this is NOT a computed 'transfer income as % of GDP' ratio. Comparing named case-study transfer fees (case_study_transfers.json) against these figures is left to the reader, deliberately, rather than turned into a single invented ratio.
